source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with mist-wrapped mountains, layered cliffs, sparse winter trees, small architectural retreats, waterfall/ravine forms, foreground boulders, and a quiet water surface. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: misty_twin_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the large pale mountain mass in the upper center-left: two soft, overlapping peaks rising out of gray mist, with broad diluted ink washes and faint contour modeling. Exclude the calligraphy on the far left and the darker stepped ridge on the right.
must_preserve: soft feathered mist edges around both peaks
pale mineral-like wash texture
subtle gray contour lines on the slopes
near-blank reserved highlights suggesting snow or fog

motifs.name: upper_right_layered_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the descending ridge on the upper right, with rounded snow-covered forms, darker contour strokes, and a small dark vegetation band along the saddle. Keep only the ridge and its attached brushwork, not the central pale peak behind it.
must_preserve: stepped rounded ridge geometry
dark dry-brush contour lines
granular ink texture on the crest
small black shrub and tree-dot band near the saddle
soft wash transitions into surrounding mist

motifs.name: distant_left_village_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the small distant settlement and winter trees at mid-left, nestled beneath the mountains. Include the low rooflines, bare-branched trees, and light horizontal ground/water marks, but exclude the calligraphy above and the large central foreground rocks.
must_preserve: tiny angular roof geometry
fine bare tree branch linework
delicate horizontal water or path strokes
pale gray atmospheric wash
scattered dark shrub dots at the base

motifs.name: central_rock_arch_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the central vertical rock formation with a natural arch-like opening and ravine shadow. Include the pale boulder masses, dark vertical crevice, and trees rooted around the opening; avoid the small houses below except where branches overlap the rock.
must_preserve: arched negative space through the rock
dark vertical ink wash inside the ravine
rounded pale rock highlights
dry-brush cracks and stippled texture
thin winter branches crossing the lower rock

motifs.name: right_waterfall_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow cliff-and-waterfall passage at middle right: a dark vertical cleft with pale falling-water streaks and flanking rock faces. Include the shrubs at the cliff base and the dark brushwork defining the drop.
must_preserve: thin vertical waterfall streaks
dark wet-ink ravine shadow
pale rock planes on both sides
fine stippled vegetation along the lower edge
soft misty transition at the top

motifs.name: hidden_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion/house group tucked among bare trees in the lower middle-left. Include the stacked roof forms, walls, path-like dark strokes, surrounding trunks, and nearby shrubs, without taking the large foreground boulder as the main subject.
must_preserve: small tiered roof geometry
fine architectural linework
clustered bare tree trunks and branches
dark footpath or stream strokes leading inward
brown-gray color accents around the buildings
dense ink shrub texture framing the retreat

motifs.name: foreground_boulder_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground rocky bank occupying the lower left and center, including the rounded white boulders, dark creases, mossy stippling, and partial bridge-like plank structure at the extreme lower left. Exclude red seals and border areas.
must_preserve: large rounded boulder silhouettes
dry-brush rock cracks and scraped highlights
dark stippled moss and shrub patches
soft gray wash shadows under the rocks
small curved plank or bridge strokes at lower left, excluding any seal impressions

motifs.name: lower_right_misty_water
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet lower-right water surface and shoreline: horizontal ink bands, pale mist strips, sparse overhanging branches, reeds, and faint warm color accents near the bank. Exclude the red seals at the bottom and the main foreground boulder to the left.
must_preserve: long horizontal water and mist strokes
soft tonal gradations in the water
thin leafless branches extending over the bank
reed-like vertical strokes near the shore
subtle reddish-brown foliage accents
open negative space suggesting calm water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
